thread:
emma: Quick ask: adding a "sensitivity slider" to the cost dashboard that previews how different sampling rates affect per-route unit-econ. Prototype PR: https://git.redwood/infra/console/pulls/720. Thoughts?

raj: useful for debugging. How will the slider interact with routing rollouts? If I move from 1% -> 10% sampling, will that change real routing decisions or only the preview?

emma: preview-only. slider controls the UI sampling used to compute the shown breakdown; it does not change router behavior. we will label it clearly: "Preview sampling (no effect on runtime routing)".

kai: backend: we'll need an endpoint param ?preview_sample=0.1 that the aggregator honors for the response. beware of heavy queries at high sample rates. cap at 20% for UI previews.

sophie: UX: show an inline estimator: "At 10% preview, expected error margin ~ ±3% (95% CI) for tenants with >1k calls/day". for low-volume tenants, recommend enabling adaptive sampling.

raj: add a compare mode that overlays current live attribution vs preview so owners can see delta. also add a small explain link about why numbers shift (sampling + weight heuristics).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: console/feature/sensitivity-slider @staging (build 720.1).

emma: action items: kai add preview_sample param with server cap; sophie add CI copy & overlay mock; raj add compare overlay + docs link. we'll run staging smoke and then 5% prod canary if stable.

kai: note: emit metric: preview_sample_request{tenant,rate_bucket} so we can monitor UI abuse. cap enforcement will return 423 if above threshold.

emma: thanks all. I'll update the PR and ping when staging is green.
